anna_platform: Morning — noticed a spike in provisional token charges for canary at 03:12 UTC, looks like reconnects re-sent a short toolcall fragment.
raj_eng: repro steps?
anna_platform: client disconnected mid-stream, server sent truncated toolcall (TOOLCALL id=tc-7f4, truncated=true). Client resumed session and resent the remainder with same session_id but different stream_offset.
liz_billing: are these provisional or confirmed charges showing up in ledger?
anna_platform: provisional only initially, but some sessions later moved to confirmed and doubled tokens for the same semantic output.
tom_sre: possible duplicate crediting when resume merges prefix + resumed chunk; ledger dedupe key uses (session_id, token_index) but token_index shifted on resume.
raj_eng: hmm — our resume path normalizes offsets but we also attempt to attribute earlier truncated prefix to the original attempt. If resumed segment overlaps, we flag as partial and issue provisional. Bug if overlap detection fails.
liz_billing: can we see sample events? paste debug trace.
anna_platform: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-18T03:12:05Z] session_resume id=sess-93 offset=64 resumed_len=128 toolcall=tc-7f4 truncated=true
[2026-03-18T03:12:05Z] ledger_provisional create key=(sess-93, prefix-0-63)
[2026-03-18T03:12:06Z] ledger_confirm id=tc-7f4 key=(sess-93, prefix-0-127)
```
raj_eng: OK looks like when resumed_len extends prefix we emit a new confirmed key that encloses both ranges rather than deduping the provisional prefix.
liz_billing: consequence = double charge for overlapping tokens.
raj_eng: proposed fix: make confirmed merge idempotent — compute minimal covering ranges and remove provisional shards covered by confirmed.
anna_platform: UX question — Console shows provisional then confirmed, but engineers want a single unified line that updates in place. Can we change UI to treat provisional as mutable?
liz_billing: yes would reduce confusion. also add toolcall_id and resume_offset in the console rows.
billing-bot: alert created #INC-2026-311 for double-charge investigation :rotating_light: 
tom_sre: also add metric for 'resume_overlap_count' in telemetry. we can gate alert on >0.1% of requests.
raj_eng: PR incoming to runtime: change ledger_confirm path to call consolidate_provisionals(key_range) before writing confirmed.
anna_platform: thanks — tagging @liz_billing for prioritization.
liz_billing: prioritizing — pls include migration script for existing provisional shards.
anna_platform: agreed. I can help with a console patch to hide provisional rows when confirmed arrives.
raj_eng: will send design tomorrow.
liz_billing: thanks all :thumbsup:
